verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships `local-ai chat`, a shell agent that takes natural-language requests, reads files and runs commands on your machine behind an approval gate. This gives a plausible natural-language path to operating the system. However, the evidence never says this agent can manage LocalAI itself (installing models, configuring backends, managing agents or users); those tasks are documented only through the CLI, web UI and API. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that natural-language commands can operate LocalAI's own features such as model install/config and agent management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
